sloka: मा रोदीर्मा च कार्षिस्त्वं देवि संपरिशोषणम् ॥२-१०-३२॥
transliteration: mā rodīrmā ca kārṣistvaṁ devi saṁpariśoṣaṇam ॥2-10-32॥

translations.english: O queen shed no tears. Drain not your health. Ask me, and I shall slay one who should not be slain or release one who should be slain. I shall make a poor man rich and a wealthy man poor. (Tell me who are such people).
